page.overview:
Who is Thormann?

Thormann is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates. He serves as a minor ally during the Egghead Arc, and, after being converted into a demon, a minor antagonist during the Elbaph Arc.

Like all giants, Thormann is a man of exceptional size, even towering over his crewmates thanks to his elongated neck. His attire seems to be inspired by s, featuring a tunic, pteruges, and a helmet to match, as well as a large coat over his shoulders. He also has a small mustache, which are absent in the anime during its first appearance.

After being converted into a demon, his appearance remained overall similar, but with a few key differences. His canines became curved and pointed, similar to an , while the horns on his helmet became more devilish. In addition, his coat seemingly converted into a large pair of wings.

From his showcase of concern for his crewmates, Thormann seems to value the brotherhood that he and his crewmates share. Despite this, he's greatly cautious, as he knew better than to assume that the demonic Dorry and Brogy could be talked down after their conversion. At the same time, his failure to watch his own footing shows a bit of a careless demeanor.
